reason: It's new, so there are no reviews and no real client photos for me to check, and I don't book anyone without those. Plus ₱1,800 is more than I'd pay for my usual mall gel set, and my sister's wedding isn't until next year, so I'm in no rush.
objection: Will gel done at home actually last like salon gel, or will it chip in a week? With no reviews from real clients I have no way to know if the artist is any good or if the kit is really clean.
would_change_my_mind: A good number of real reviews and before-and-after photos from actual Cainta clients, especially ones that show how the nails looked two or three weeks later.
